title: GenoMAS: Guided Multi-Agent Programming for Scientific Discovery from Genomic Data
abstract: arXiv:2507.21035v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Gene expression analysis holds the key to many biomedical discoveries, yet extracting insights from raw transcriptomic data remains challenging due to the complexity of multiple large, semi-structured files and the need for extensive domain expertise. Current approaches either rely on inflexible workflows that fail in edge cases or fully autonomous agents that lack the precision required for rigorous scientific inquiry. GenoMAS addresses this by presenting a team of LLM-based agents that integrates structured workflows with autonomous adaptability, orchestrating diverse specialized agents through typed message-passing protocols. At its core lies a guided-planning framework where programming agents decompose task guidelines into Action Units and dynamically choose to advance, revise, bypass, or backtrack, maintaining logical coherence while adapting to the idiosyncrasies of genomic data. On the GenoTEX benchmark, GenoMAS achieves 89.1

translated_title: GenoMAS：用于基因组数据科学发现的引导式多智能体编程
translated_abstract: 基因表达分析是许多生物医学发现的关键所在，然而由于多个大型半结构化文件的复杂性以及对广泛领域专业知识的需求，从原始转录组数据中提取见解仍然极具挑战性。现有方法要么依赖于在边缘情况下失效的僵化工作流程，要么依赖于缺乏严谨科学探究所需精度的完全自主智能体。GenoMAS通过提出一个基于大语言模型的智能体团队来解决这一问题，该团队将结构化工作流程与自主适应性相融合，通过类型化消息传递协议协调多种专业化智能体。其核心是一个引导式规划框架，编程智能体将任务指南分解为动作单元，并动态选择推进、修改、绕过或回溯，在适应基因组数据特异性的同时保持逻辑连贯性。在GenoTEX基准测试中，GenoMAS达到了89.1
tldr: GenoMAS提出了一种引导式多智能体编程框架，通过将结构化工作流与自主决策相结合，让编程智能体动态选择推进、修改、绕过或回溯动作单元，实现了从复杂基因组数据中可靠地进行科学发现。
en_tdlr: GenoMAS presents a guided multi-agent programming framework that integrates structured workflows with autonomous adaptability, allowing LLM-based programming agents to dynamically advance, revise, bypass, or backtrack through Action Units for reliable scientific discovery from genomic data.
